completion_override.EOS_and_frozen_stop: Both count as completed. Raw finish reason remains stored.

bootstrap.unit: request, separately within each domain and arm
bootstrap.bounds: Sorted bootstrap replicates at zero-based indices100 and3899. Paired accuracy differences resample common request IDs.

work_accounting.recorded_decode_core_pass_work: sum(depth_events.depth). Excludes full R4 prefill and first output token.
work_accounting.normalized_decode_depth: recorded decode core-pass work divided by recorded decode positions
work_accounting.layer_execution_proxy: physical layer count times recorded decode core-pass work. This is an operation-count proxy, not FLOPs, memory traffic, timing, or a causal ready frontier.

quality_interpretation: Baseline operating-point comparison only. No candidate quality, noninferiority, official-paper reproduction, or architecture speedup.
partial_runs: Do not admit incomplete arms into completed benchmark rows. Preserve partial outputs and failures.
held_out: All original held-out IDs remain excluded.
